name: 抽取式棉柔洗脸巾干湿两用款
description: 抽取式一次性洗脸巾，干湿两用，绵柔触感，居家洁面擦拭多场景

styleLock.backgroundSystem: clean white #FFFFFF for packshots, misty mint #D9E9E5 for hero and closing, deep teal-grey #3B535C for info bands, warm cream #EFE9E1 for lifestyle and macro
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft studio lighting, front-left key with gentle fill, soft contact shadows, no harsh speculars
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte light-stone counter #E7E2DC and soft fabric-textured board #EFE9E1
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line icons with a single warm accent, small leaf motif allowed
styleLock.presentationRules: pack sits stable and centered; consistent pack scale across the set; sheets rendered soft and airy
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent clean fresh daily-necessities visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of cloud white #FFFFFF, misty mint #D9E9E5, deep teal-grey #3B535C and one caramel accent #C9A287; bright soft studio lighting with front-left key and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif; consistent thin-line icon style with a small leaf motif; clean high-end product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable centered pack placement and scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

provenance.notes: 逐屏事实：P1 雾薄荷 3D 展台主视觉，抽取包置于圆形棱纹展台，标题主张含材质百分比字样；P2 深青灰横条内四枚细线圆图标（材质/触感/干湿两用/无添加类主张）；P2 下半「好材温和细腻」段落；P3 沙发上人物取用生活场景（模特可辨识面容）+「净化车间品控」认证类段落与两张白卡；P4-5 编号 01-04 的四宫格用法图，标签条为焦糖杏色；P5 下半深青灰参数区，三条重复的名称+材质胶囊行；P6 白色圆角卡片内 15cm×20cm 尺寸标注图 +「真实拍摄」段落；P7 两块空白大图位 + 会员二维码贴片。品类判定：源夹名为「洗护」，但参数区品名为洗脸巾/棉柔巾，属一次性清洁用品，taxonomy 无专设品类，按最接近的「家居日用/纸品清洁」判定；为一次性干巾而非护肤膏霜，不归护肤个护。已剥离：原品牌名与全英文字样、模特面容（改为肩部以上裁切的 generic person）、材质百分比与无添加/净化车间/认证类主张（全部改为 {selling_point_n}/{callout_n} 或空白占位）、15cm/20cm 与抽数等规格数值（改为空白尺寸标注与空参数行）、会员二维码贴片、原文案原句。源页自相矛盾处：P5 参数区同一行名称与材质内容连续重复三次且数值口径不一，两说均未采信，参数全部留空。
